newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Swire Pacific surges on laggard buying.
newsitem.headline: Swire Pacific surges on laggard buying.

text.p: Shares of Swire Pacific Ltd surged on Monday as investors hunted for blue-chip laggards following the recent sharp rally by banks, property stocks and red chips, brokers said.
The stock jumped HK$2.50, or 3.84 percent, to HK$67.50 in late morning trading.

"The conglomerate is seriously lagging behind the recent market rally," said Micheal Ng, dealing director at Sassoon Securities. Swire shares were trading around eight percent below their close of HK$73.75 at the end of 1996, while the Hang Seng Index has surged more than 10 percent so far this year.
